name: UniProtKB (Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL)
scope: Protein sequences with curated function, domains, variants, PTMs and cross-references. 20,431 reviewed (Swiss-Prot) human entries. The humsavar variant index (release 2026_03, 02-Sep-2026) lists 85,015 rows for 83,859 distinct Swiss-Prot human missense variants (rows 33,333 LP/P, 39,964 LB/B, 11,718 US; a variant with several diseases has one row per disease) with ACMG/AMP-style categories curated from the literature.
formats: flat files and FASTA on FTP
mapping_methods: Cross-references to Ensembl, RefSeq, HGNC, PDB and AlphaFold DB.

quantitative.summary: Mostly categorical annotation; curated variant effects as text.

coverage_limitations: Variant sections are not systematic experimental measurements
humsavar categories are literature-curated, for research use only (stated in the file) and may change; protein-level only (UniProt canonical numbering), no genomic coordinates

reuse_decision.rationale: Primary source; fetch the reviewed human table with identifier cross-references (needed to join protein-level MaveDB targets to genes and structures) and the humsavar missense variant index (a protein-level clinical annotation that joins to MaveDB variants through UniProt accession and amino-acid change).
